# The Wellness Advocate

> A membership-based direct primary care practice in Jacksonville, Florida. One provider, Aimee Roberts-Serrato, MSN, APRN, a dual board-certified nurse practitioner (FNP-C and PMHNP-BC), offers primary care, bioidentical hormone replacement therapy (BHRT) consultations, and psychiatry and mental health care under one flat monthly membership, without insurance billing.

Key facts:

- Model: direct primary care (DPC). Patients pay the practice a flat monthly membership fee instead of the practice billing insurance per visit. Membership is not insurance; it does not cover hospital care, emergency care, specialists, imaging or pharmacy prescriptions.
- Location: Jacksonville, Florida.
- Provider: Aimee Roberts-Serrato, MSN, APRN, PMHNP-BC, FNP-C. Master of Science in Nursing, University of Cincinnati (2016); post-master's certificate, Florida State University (2022).
- Services: primary care; bioidentical hormone replacement therapy consultations guided by lab work; psychiatric evaluation and medication management for adults.
- Booking and the patient portal run through OptiMantra.
- Not for emergencies: in a mental health crisis, call or text 988 (988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline). For an emergency, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room.
- Website content is general information, not medical advice.
